support.title: Help, features & bugs
support.description: Read the help guide, suggest a feature, or report a bug on GitHub. Forms include your installed plugin version automatically. A GitHub account is needed to submit; nothing is submitted until you review and send it.
support.openFailed: Could not open the browser. Check your default browser configuration.
support.versionFailed: Could not read the installed plugin version. Issue forms are unavailable; check the shell log.
read.saveFailed: Could not load or save read status. Check the shell log and try again.
setup.title: Setup
setup.limitDescription: Choose up to 50, 100, or 150 videos for the next manual or automatic refresh. YouTube may return fewer. Existing lists and counts update on their next successful search.
setup.description: Automatic refresh searches YouTube at the chosen interval, even with this panel closed, using the current date filter. Off disables scheduled searches. Opening the panel does not refresh; use Refresh for an immediate search. Settings are remembered across shell restarts.
setup.saveFailed: Could not load or save refresh settings. Check the shell log and try again.
panel.title: Omarchy on YouTube
panel.searchFailed: Search failed. Check your connection and yt-dlp, then refresh.
panel.searchingNote: YouTube filters this range before returning up to %1 Omarchy matches, including Shorts. Newest first; dates are approximate. Undated results appear last. All means no date limit, not every video.
panel.empty: No videos match this date range.
range.notSearched: No cached count yet. Search this filter to see its unread count.

range.cachedUnread.one: %1 unread video in this filter's last successful search (up to %2 results). Counts may be stale; filters overlap.
range.cachedUnread.other: %1 unread videos in this filter's last successful search (up to %2 results). Counts may be stale; filters overlap.

video.unknownError: yt-dlp did not provide an error message.
